papers.title: Adaptive State Reasoning
papers.current_ceiling: The scoped observation-regret law is exact, but promotion is not earned; price and distribution-shift robustness axes are explicitly broken without retuning.
post_matrix_updates: The 36-class law and transfer results remain bounded evidence; no later commit licenses robust public transfer.
load_bearing_adverse: The price_axis and distribution_shift_axis are BROKEN.
The second-family E3-or-E2 transfer and hidden-parameter audit are unrun.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The unchanged allocator must be tested under prospectively altered prices, task distributions and hidden parameters, including both zero- and positive-regret observation classes.
papers.decisive_question: Does one frozen allocator maintain low regret and correctly distinguish zero- versus positive-regret information classes under price changes, task-family shift and hidden-parameter perturbations in a second domain?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Observation-regret structure supports robust online allocation across specified shifts without retuning.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: The allocator's decisions should remain near the full-information oracle, preserve zero-regret classes and exploit positive-regret classes under all predeclared shifts.
papers.population_or_universe: All eligible tasks in one prospectively selected paper-disjoint E3 or E2 family crossed with frozen price schedules, distribution shifts and hidden-parameter perturbations.
papers.unit_of_analysis: Task × observation class × shift condition × allocator.
design: Choose E3 or E2 before protocol freeze and document paper-disjointness.
Freeze unchanged allocator code and all shift generators.
Include both zero-regret and positive-regret classes by design.
Audit hidden parameters and cache/state leakage.
Compare full-information oracle, current price-blind and strong myopic policies.
primary_endpoints: Calibration of predicted regret floor and full resource cost.
negative_controls: Pure price rescaling that should preserve ranking.
Hidden parameter exposed only to one arm.
analysis_plan: Shift-family effects are predeclared and reported separately.
Worst-case shift performance is a co-primary endpoint.
Uncertainty clusters by task and shift generator.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Use the full frozen shift grid and all eligible tasks, or prospectively power the worst-case regret contrast at the task-cluster level.
papers.success_gate: The unchanged allocator stays within the frozen regret tolerance of the oracle, preserves all zero-regret classes and outperforms fixed/myopic policies on positive-regret classes across every required shift family.
papers.refutation_gate: Failure on a required shift, hidden-parameter leakage or need for retuning blocks robustness promotion while retaining the scoped law.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if allocator bytes, prices, shift generators, hidden parameters or full resource vectors are not frozen and independently auditable.
papers.authority_required: Objective task verifiers plus an independent allocator/resource checker.

active_lane.collision_rule: Select exactly one new domain before freeze and keep tasks disjoint from ORION-08/21.

immediate_safe_actions: Freeze the unchanged allocator hash and define all shift generators.
Choose E3 or E2 with a written paper-disjoint split.
forbidden_actions: Do not retune under price/distribution shift.
Do not report average regret while hiding a failed required axis.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier metareasoning paper needs unchanged-policy robustness, worst-case shift endpoints, hidden-parameter audits, zero/positive regimes and full resource accounting.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns online allocation under changing prices; state construction/placement belongs to ORION-08/21.
